[[File:Murgoob_from_SWE.png|thumb|right|upright|Murgoob was a Dulok oracle.]]
An '''oracle''' was a member of a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] group on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] who was respected for wisdom and sound judgment. [[Murgoob]] was the oracle of [[Gorneesh's tribe]]. It was at Murgoob's suggestion that the Duloks turned the captured [[Ewok battle wagon]] against the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]' [[Soul Tree]]s in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Wicket's Wagon">{{Ewoks|Wicket's Wagon}}</ref>
